title: Very nice!
text: Very nice!. I really like this bathroom rug. It is a nice shaggy style. I got the darker tanish color and it looks very nice in my bathroom. It doesnt slid around on tye floor because of the gripper backing. Would look nice in any room.

product_metadata.title: VANZAVANZU Toilet Rugs for Bathroom U Shaped, Contour Bath Rugs for Toilet Bath Mats for Bathroom Non Slip Extra Soft Absorbant Microfiber Shaggy Thick Toilet Rugs U Shaped (U 20"*24", Petal Pink)
features: 🏠ULTRA THICK & SOFT🏠 - Compared with most other brands, our bathroom rugs are made of denser and thicker fluffy microfiber. Suitable for use as a floor mat, bedroom mat, back door mat, laundry mat, living room mat, office mat, etc. Great for bathroom, vanity, vacation home, master bathroom, kids bathroom, guest suite.
